purpose: The hub. Let a founder pick one of three goals in seconds, see published starting prices, then browse every service and the industry packages.

seo.title: Services | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Every Alliance AI Partners service, sorted by goal: scale AI, solve problems with AI, and grow. Published starting prices and ready-made packages for common industries.

sections.name: Hero
sections.job: Say that every service sits under three goals, show the starting prices, and offer the one committing action.
sections.desktop: Split 1.08fr | 1fr: text (Display/XL title, Body/LG lead 560, Primary LG + link, caption) left; an unboxed price list right on Daylight (Heading/3 title, a strong top rule, four hairline price rows with mono prices, the AI-usage footnote and a link). No card in the hero. Never centred.
sections.mobile: Title, lead, full-width Primary, link, caption. The price card moves below the three goals (result first, price second).

content.heading: Three goals. One team.
content.lead: Every service we offer sits under one of three goals: scale AI across your company, solve the problems that slow your team down, or grow. Start with one service and add more when you need them.
body: Every project gets a fixed quote before work starts, and you own what we build.

sections.name: Three goals
sections.job: The way in: one large split row per goal, image and text alternating sides, each listing its categories and linking to the goal page.
sections.desktop: Three rows, zig-zag: image 620x520 left (Scale AI), right (Solve problems with AI), left (Grow); text column with service icon, Heading/2, Body/LG lead, categories in a two-column hairline list, link. 96 px between rows.
sections.mobile: One column per goal: icon and title, lead, image under the lead re-cropped to 4:3 (358x268), categories as tags, link.

items.title: Scale AI
items.text: Plan, build and run AI across the company. We train your people to use it and add engineers when you need more hands.
items.meta: Strategy and leadership · Training and adoption · Software and product engineering · Running AI for you · Robotics and physical AI · Talent and teams

items.title: Solve problems with AI
items.text: Fix the jobs that slow your team down: the copying, chasing and checking that fill a week. AI does the repetitive steps, and a person checks the result.
items.meta: Automation and AI agents · Customer support · Knowledge and data · Design · Security and risk

items.title: Grow
items.text: Win more customers, with AI doing the repetitive part of your marketing and sales. Your team spends its time on the people who buy.
items.meta: Marketing · Sales and go-to-market · Online stores

images.alt: One ribbon river branching into channels that reach every terrace of a faceted hillside.
images.source: Editorial illustration on a soft Daylight background, landscape 6:5, safe to crop to 4:3. At the upper left a single satin ribbon river in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan begins as one stream, then branches into many smaller ribbon channels that run down across a wide hillside of terraces built from flat paper facets in slate blues, so one source reaches every level: AI reaching every team in a company. Small faceted trees stand on each terrace, taller on the lower terraces where the channels have arrived. Calm open Daylight sky in the top quarter, nothing important near the edges. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

content.heading: Ready-made for your industry.
content.lead: We package popular services for specific industries. Projects in healthcare, finance, insurance and legal start with a privacy and compliance review, because those industries have stricter rules about data.

content.heading: Tell us what slows you down.
content.lead: Start with the AI check-up, our usual first project. We learn how your business works, find where AI could save you time or money, and hand you a plan with a fixed quote. If the answer doesn’t involve AI, we’ll say so.

notes: Hub page. The three goals come first (Brand DNA note 1), the full list second. Starting prices appear only as [PRICE]; Private AI is marked not available yet. The hero carries the page’s Primary; the closing band carries the second, out of view of the first. No sourced figures on this page, so no source list. Review 2026-11-03: the hero price card is now an unboxed ruled list (no cards in the hero) and its sub-line was cut; the full-list lead no longer repeats the hero’s “start with one service”; one-word last lines in six headings balanced with soft line breaks.
